dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I don't recognize that voice... Are you a traveler from afar?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Though I can't see, I'm always here to listen if there's anything you need.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Sorry, where are my manners! Allow me to introduce myself — I'm Glory.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I come here often, waiting for Godwin to come back... I pray he manages to avoid those rotten hilichurls and the Abyss Order on the way... so he can come back and be with me soon.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm rambling again... Sorry, it's just so nice having someone to talk to.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: He's the man I love. He's with the Knights, and he's away with Grand Master Varka's expedition.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: It was hard to let him go, but I was so proud of him managing to join Varka's expedition party.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: ...Sadly, I don't know when the expedition is supposed to end. All I can do is wait here for him.

choices.text: Tell me more about the hilichurls and the Abyss Order.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: You must find them a nuisance too? All they do is go round causing mischief.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: I heard that most of the hilichurls suddenly appeared in Teyvat out of nowhere several hundred years ago... And the same for the Abyss Order, actually.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: Some said they were borne of some great catastrophe that descended on Teyvat... But I think they probably came from outer space!

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: ...Sorry, because I can't see, my imagination sometimes runs a bit wild. Just ignore it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It must be difficult not being able to see.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Yes... Especially at the beginning, it was hard to adjust.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: But when you can't see, your sense of hearing becomes stronger. Now, when the wind brushes past my ears, I can almost picture certain things in my mind's eye...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: And since putting my faith in Lord Barbatos, I sometimes hear the whisper of a soothing voice carried on the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: My mother — or "Sister Grace" to everyone else — always tells me that Mondstadt is looked after by the Anemo Archon. I think she's right, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Bye-bye.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Hope you enjoy your stay in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I obviously couldn't see what happened in Mondstadt when Stormterror attacked, so I only know what other people have told me.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: People's voices were full of fear during that time, but recently the sounds of anguish have finally died down.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Mondstadt's wind, too, has finally calmed down again.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Lord Barbatos... Please see to it that Goldwin gets home soon and safe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: #Huh? Pardon me... That voice... {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I still come here often, waiting for Godwin to come back... I pray he steers clear of those rotten hilichurls and the Abyss Order on the way... so he can come back to me soon.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm rambling again... Sorry, it's just so nice having someone to talk to.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: Grand Master Varka told me that Godwin's expedition isn't over yet. He'll be continuing his fight in Nod-Krai...

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: I've received many letters from him recently. They're always so long... as if there's something he wants to say, but can't quite bring himself to put into words, so he keeps circling around it instead.

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: ...He doesn't need to say that much. I already understand what he's trying to tell me. I suppose you know that feeling too, right?

response.speaker: Glory
response.text: That's why I want to believe... this time, he'll keep his promise.
